episode_budget.context_policy: Preserve the complete visible tool transcript and provider reasoning state. Do not silently truncate or provider-specifically summarize. Fail closed as context_budget_exhaustion if a provider cannot accept the visible transcript.
episode_budget.compaction_policy: No automatic compaction in the development pilot; explicit state capsules are allowed only if the same predeclared mechanism is used for every model.

submission_policy.accepted_submission: Deterministically graded; reliability equals coverage-adjusted scientific score.
submission_policy.usable_unsubmitted: Reliability score is zero while all parseable artifact scores remain diagnostic.
submission_policy.verified_infrastructure_failure: Excluded from scientific scoring and eligible for one same-cell retry.
submission_policy.provider_adapter_failure: Excluded from scientific scoring, blocks the affected provider, and may not be relabelled as model failure.
submission_policy.provider_policy_refusal: Reported separately and excluded when the provider explicitly blocks the benign workflow before usable work.
submission_policy.context_budget_exhaustion: Scientific completion failure with zero reliability; never treated as an adapter or infrastructure exclusion.
submission_policy.unknown_harness_failure: Reported separately and excluded pending diagnosis; never silently treated as infrastructure.

continuation_rules.scenario_loss_concentration: report_not_gate; mathematically non-identifiable against a 30% maximum from two sentinel states; evaluate only after all six states
